title: SmartCocoon Register Booster Fan – Smart Cocoon

og.title: SmartCocoon Register Booster Fan
og.description: Tired of that one room that's always too hot or too cold? SmartCocoon's smart register booster fan boosts airflow by up to 300%, automatically syncs with your HVAC, and gives you full app control. Easy DIY setup, just plug it in. Better airflow, more comfort, lower energy bills. Works with any thermostat.
